basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer | Production Agentic AI | Enterprise HR & Employee Platforms | FDE Practice
basics.summary: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer by practice. Run Anand Creations as an independent FDE practice: embed with teams, run discovery, ship production agentic AI end to end. At LumApps I own a production multi-agent system on the employee experience platform (integrates Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo via a temporal knowledge graph, MCP-authored tool servers, evals + on-call), reporting to C-level. Prior 6 years at Beekeeper, the frontline workforce platform: multi-tenant SaaS serving 10M+ users, enterprise SLA, cross-team integrations. 13+ years shipping production; remote-native since 2018.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI. Tools over MCP servers I authored; integrations into Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pendo via OAuth/service accounts; idempotent write-back with retry and audit log. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.
Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j unifying 5+ silos into one auditable time-aware store. Grounds RAG so agents stop hallucinating; event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub.

Own reliability, observability, evals, and on-call: golden suites with behavioral assertions, LangSmith tracing so every run reconstructs from its log, cost-per-request instrumentation, fallback paths. Report to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Multi-tenant SaaS for a frontline workforce platform (HR-adjacent, 10M+ users). Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, Vue, PostgreSQL); became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Direct engagement with enterprise customers.
Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). Concept to production, then transitioned ownership to product team.
Ran observability and global on-call across K8s + AWS (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse). Enterprise SLA (99.99%), data privacy by design.
Read, debugged, and improved codebases across 3 teams. Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Interviewed and evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC decisions. Structured discovery is the whole job.
Advised portfolio companies on production AI adoption, compliance constraints, and shipping in enterprise contexts.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ deliveries.
Direct engagement with enterprise partners (Unilever). Ran structured discovery with each partner and turned prototypes into signed opportunities and a CES showcase.
